feeds.title: Quietly Saving
feeds.description: I'm Weenie. In 2014, I came across the term FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early). I set up this blog, devised a plan, began to save more and invest.I try to balance enjoying my life in the present while attempting to plan for the future. My plan is to be in a position to not have to work full-time (or at all) by 2025 (or 2024, depending on whether I want to do 'one more year').This blog is not a 'how-to' guide and doesn't give advice, it's just a journal documenting my progress, plus some of my occasionally mad thoughts and ideas.

feeds.title: Maturing Well
feeds.description: This blog is all about staying in good shape through the different seasons of life. By staying in good shape I mean physical and mental good health, plus getting the life-style right and managing the progression through life. I will be bringing articles and blog posts about making sure we stay healthy.

feeds.title: RetireEasy Blog
feeds.description: The RetireEasy 'LifePlan' retirement planner is a online tool enabling the creation of a comprehensive plan for retirement, empowering retirees to visualise future income, expenses & deal with multiple scenarios. Our key aim is to try & remove some of the fear for those entering later life by providing an online retirement planner that is free, easy-to use, intuitive & easy to understand.

feeds.title: A Retirement Blog by Caree Risover
feeds.description: UK retirement lifestyle blog. Caree Risover shares her thoughts creativity and adventure. Responding to the meagre number of UK retirement lifestyle blogs, Caree Risover charts her retirement through planning to implementation and enjoyment. Her retirement blog shares her quest for a meaning to retired life with details of her thoughts, creativity, travel and even her vegetable plot .

feeds.title: Retirement Investing Today
feeds.description: RetirementInvestingToday analyses the economic data, market data and and investing strategies that I am using to reach Early Retirement. Our mission is to achieve Early Retirement by maximising salary contributions, minimising fees, minimising taxes, maximising return through tactical allocations and minimising investing mistakes.

feeds.title: A Retirement Blog by Caree Risover
feeds.description: Caree Risover shares retired pleasure, thought, creativity and adventure. Caree Risover charts her retirement through planning to implementation and enjoyment.

feeds.title: I Retired Young
feeds.description: I retired young, at 47. I'm blogging how much it costs to live and what I do with my extra free time in case this helps with your own decision to retire early.

feeds.title: Having Fun Cracking Retirement
feeds.description: Articles on retirement planning, retired life, travel, health and everything related to retirement. I took early retirement in 2011, having just turned 56. Over the past 5 years, I have been making the most of all the free time that retirement brings. I'm fortunate enough to be healthy and also have enough money to indulge my passions of travel, investing and working with metal of all shapes and styles.

feeds.description: Pension Works is one of the UK's leading independent, Defined Benefit Advice specialists. Our mission is to help bring sound financial advice to people from all walks of life. We pride ourselves on our open and transparent advice that always puts you first, and we will only ever make recommendations that would be in your best financial interests.

feeds.title: Notes From Retirement......................Where did the years go?
feeds.description: Blog by John Brassey ex MD of Instanta. I retired year back but have continued blogging after enjoying writing Instanta's blog for several years.This blog is charting our retirement and now and then there may be some words of helpful advice to businesses gained from my 40 years experience.
